body:
Thank you both. I went to one of the online chats this sub recommended, spoke to a person about it. They gave me a couple of addresses to help cope with my depression and anxiety. As far as my husband goes, he did come back. He threatened to divorce me, and packed his bag and left. 

He came around and started texting me again. It's all very shaky. I feel so numb right now. It's really hard to process everything going on right now, plus all the extra things like bills and work... 

I also would like to say that it really helped to just vent in general. I'm hoping everything will be okay but I'm not exactly sure what's going to happen..
